name: What common mistakes or risks should I avoid when using AEO software?

mainEntity.name: What common mistakes or risks should I avoid when using AEO software?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest AEO risks include over-optimizing for short phrases (AI prefers 160-character answer blocks), using generic content that LLMs already know, and ignoring multimodal formats like video and images. AI engines also favor fresh, authoritative content, so outdated or link-heavy pages get cited less frequently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid over-optimizing short phrases, using generic content LLMs already know, and ignoring video/images. AI favors fresh, authoritative content in 160-character blocks and multimodal formats.
